tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The KNNL reserves the right of rejecting all or any of the tenders without assigning any reasons

All the above original certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of tenders for verification. Contractors who will not produce original certificates at the time of opening liable for rejection
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
Corrigendum will be published in the website
A monthly programmed of works has to be submitted by successful bidder at the time of concluding agreement
If any certificate/ information furnished by the bidder is found false, such bidder will be disqualified at the time of evaluation.
The validity period for E.M.D. shall be for a minimum period of 90 plus 45 days from the date of opening of tenders.
The agency should upload all documents. The agency which has been blacklisted will be disqualified from the tender process

As per proceedings of the Government of Karnataka and Government Order No. LD 300 LET 2006 Bangalore dated 18.01.2007 and Corrigendum dated 28.02.2007, 1percent of the amount of cost approved as per the tender notification will be deducted from the bill at the time of payment ascess for the Karnataka State Building & Other Construction Works Welfare Board
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner

Bidder Should upload the bid capacity calculated as per Bid Document Tender condition, the statements showing the value of existing commitment and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or Equivalent. False representations in the statements leads to disqualification of the tender as per applicable clause

Successful bidder should produce within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit for an amount equivalent to percent of the Contract price (only for Unreserved Category Works only)
The agency should upload all documents. The agency which has been blacklisted will be disqualified from the tender process
Office will provide the monthly attendance details of deployed manpower to prepare a bill by contractor
On the basis of bill, contractor shall pay the wages, ESI and EPF to each employee
Pay-slip shall be provided to deployed manpower and pay statement shall be submitted to the Office every month
If the Price quoted by contractor for the Manpower works is below the DSR rates / Minimum wages including EPF, ESI and Other Taxes, such tenderer will be rejected
As the Manpower Works are Lumpsum Commercial Bid type, so the Price quoted by contractor should be in Lumpsum value
The invoices of GST bill paid, ESI, EPF previously paid should be enclosed with pay bill.
The monthly bills should be submitted in the GST invoice submitted to the Registered Office, Bangalore.
The persons employed through the agency are not permanent Government employees, hence their service may be dismissed any time

The agency for any reason should not give less salary than that stipulated by the WRD/ Labor Dept./ PWD Dept. for Man Power Works, if PRICE agency quoted below the minimum wages, then the tender will not be accepted

The percentage/price quoted for the service charge for tendering services shall be equal to or can be above minimum wages. Service charges shall not be negative and zero limiting to first decimal. Negative tenders will be strictly rejected.

If there are more than one number of L1 bidders then the bidders selection will be done by lottery process at division office level and the decision of the tender inviting authority is final in this regard.
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
A monthly programe of works has to be submitted by successful bidder at the time of concluding agreement
If any certificate/ information furnished by the bidder is found false, such bidder will be disqualified at the time of evaluation
The agency should upload all documents. The agency which has been blacklisted will be disqualified from the tender process

As per proceedings of the Government of Karnataka and Government Order No. LD 300 LET 2006 Bangalore dated 18.01.2007 and Corrigendum dated 28.02.2007, 1% of the amount of cost approved as per the tender notification will be deducted from the bill at the time of payment as cess for the Karnataka State Building & Other Construction Works Welfare Board
